en.bdb: The Sikhs from country and abroad

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਨਾ ਮਲਣੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਕਾਬਲਿ ਰੇਖਰਾਉ ਗੁਰਭਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: bhaanaa malan jaaneeaai kaabal rekharaau gurbhaiee|

en.bdb: Bhana Malhan and Rekh Rao, the fellow disciples of the Guru are known to be residing in Kabul.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਧੋ ਸੋਢੀ ਕਾਸਮੀਰ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਦੀ ਚਾਲ ਚਲਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: maadho soddee kaasameer gursikhee dhee chaal chalaiee|

en.bdb: Madho Sodhi made the Sikh tradition in vogue in Kashmir.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਈ ਭੀਵਾਂ ਸੀਹਰੰਦਿ ਰੂਪ ਚੰਦੁ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਤ ਭਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: bhaiee bheevaa(n) seehara(n)dh roop cha(n)dh sanamukh sat bhaiee|

en.bdb: The truly devoted and close Sikhs are Bhai Bhiva, Sih Chand and Rup Chand (of Sirhind).

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਤਾਪੂ ਸਿਖੁ ਸੂਰਮਾ ਨੰਦੈ ਵਿਠੜਿ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: parataapoo sikh sooramaa na(n)dhai viThaR sev kamaiee|

en.bdb: Bhai Partapu is a brave Sikhs and Vithar caste Bhai Nanda has also served the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਮੀਦਾਸ ਵਛੇਰੁ ਹੈ ਥਾਨੇਸੁਰਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਹਲਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: saameedhaas vachher hai thaanesur sa(n)gat bahalaiee|

en.bdb: Bhai Sami Das of Bachher caste inspired the congregation of Thanesar towards the house of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੋਪੀ ਮਹਤਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਨਥਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: gopee mahataa jaaneeaai teerath nathaa gur saranaiee|

en.bdb: Gopi, a Mehta Sikh is a well known and Tirath and Natha have also come in the shelter of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਊ ਮੋਕਲੁ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਢਿਲੀ ਮੰਡਲਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: bhaauoo mokal aakhe'eeh ddilee ma(n)ddal gurmat paiee|

en.bdb: Bhai Bhau, Mokal, Bhai Dhilli and Bhai Mandal are also said to have been bapitised in the Gurmat.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਦੁ ਜਗਸੀ ਫਤੇਪੁਰਿ ਸੇਠਿ ਤਲੋਕੇ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: jeevadh jagasee fatepur seTh taloke sev kamaiee|

en.bdb: Bhai Jivanda, Bhai Jagasi and Tiloka have served well at fatehpur.
Great is the grandeur of the true Guru.
